COO’s Office / Operations

发布源: Institute of Strategic and International Studies (ISIS) – MalaysiaThis link opens in a new window | 抓取时间: 2026-08-11

The Administration provides office support to both individuals and teams and is vital for the smooth running of ISIS Malaysia. Responsibilities typically include scheduling and coordinating appointments, meetings, engagements and daily activities, creating and updating databases with personnel, financial and other data, monitoring financial transactions, supporting budgeting and bookkeeping procedures, clerical duties, managing travel arrangements, as well as maintaining office equipment, buildings and grounds.

item.description: 网站专栏报告。作者: 智库研究员。这篇智库文章初次发表在Institute of Strategic and International Studies (ISIS) – MalaysiaThis link opens in a new window官方网站上。
item.content:encoded:
Executive Chairman’s Office

发布源: Institute of Strategic and International Studies (ISIS) – MalaysiaThis link opens in a new window | 抓取时间: 2026-08-11

The office is responsible for supporting the management in decision-making and stakeholder engagement, including with the government, corporations, foreign governments and embassies, and other think-tanks. Additionally, it assists the Chairman to draft policy recommendations for key decision-makers in Malaysia and abroad.

Executive ChairmanInstitute of Strategic & International Studies (ISIS)Malaysia

Prof Faiz leads the institute’s policy development and Track 2 diplomacy, including through the ASEAN Institutes of Strategic and International Studies and Pacific Economic Cooperation Council. He is also the Malaysian representative to the ASEAN Regional Forum Experts and Eminent Persons meeting, co-chair of the Council for Security Cooperation in the Asia-Pacific and a member of the World Economic Forum’s Global Future Council on Good Governance.

News AnchorAstro AWANI

Farhana presents AWANI International, Astro’s flagship English news segment analysing global power shifts and geopolitical rivalries shaping the international order. She also hosts the weekly talk show It’s About Youth, leading discussions with diverse guests on issues central to young Malaysians. Her expertise extends across the organisation, contributing to major programmes, including AWANI Global, Agenda AWANI and Dialog ASEAN25.
